    Ge'or Art — Complete Prompt Library¶

    Art Style: Yani Neko / Slice-of-Life Anime¶

    Model: bytedance-seed/seedream-4.5 (~$0.04/image)¶

    Negative Prompt Block (always include these rules)¶

    Slice-of-life anime aesthetic, grounded realistic proportions, clean linework, soft natural shading, Mushoku Tensei quality. NOT childlike proportions — adult body, adult face. NOT moe, NOT chibi, NOT loli. No text, no watermarks, no labels. No modern clothing — medieval fantasy only. If rings appear in the sky, they must be a single straight continuous band from left horizon to right horizon, not crossing, not forming an X.

    Mood Palettes¶

    Mood Lighting Good For
    Golden Hour Warm orange, long shadows, calm water reflections Catmen, Halflings, peaceful species
    Misty Dawn Soft gray, diffused light, fog, cold breath visible Angels, Wolvesfolk, Coldspeople
    Desert Sun Harsh overhead, heat haze, bleached tones Sandsmen, Orcs, Kobra snakes
    Firelight Night Orange glow on faces, dark background, sparks Demons, Wolvesfolk, Ogres
    Overcast Gray Flat light, moody, introspective Treemen, Dragons (Kramsadar), Owlkin
    Alpine Cold Blue-white, snow glare, crisp air Angels, Coldspeople, Giants
    Swamp Gloom Green-brown light through canopy, humid Ogres, Kutra, Slimes
    Ocean Dusk Pink-purple sky, glittering water Yaoma, Seafolk, Merfolk

    SPECIES PROMPTS¶

    ALREADY HAVE ART¶

    Files live in World/Assets/Species/ — Chi & Mikhail in Ge'or Arts/. - Catmen (Erisdarian) — Catgirl.png ✓ - Lesser Catmen — Lesser Catgirl.png ✓ - Malgaridans — Malgardian.png ✓ - Titians — Titian.png ✓ - Bloodcoast Folk — Bloodcoast_Folk.png ✓ - Chi & Mikhail — Chi_and_Mikhail_Geor.png ✓

    NEED ART¶

    ORCS¶

    Mood: Desert Sun / Firelight

    A young orc woman standing at a blacksmith's forge in the warm light of a medieval workshop. She has olive-green skin, small tusks visible at the corners of her mouth, a strong muscular build but undeniably feminine. Her expression is focused and calm — she is proud of her craft. She wears a leather smithing apron over simple clothes, her arms bare and soot-stained. Behind her, tools hang on stone walls, embers glow in the forge. The kingdom of Augamouth is civilized — this is a place of honest work. [NEGATIVE BLOCK]

    SNAKE PEOPLE¶

    Mood: Desert Sun

    A snake woman queen sitting on a stone throne in warm desert light. She has a humanoid upper body and a long serpentine tail coiled at her feet. Smooth amber scales with intricate painted patterns telling her life story. Her face is regal and proud — slit-pupiled golden eyes, a subtle forked tongue visible between her lips. She wears ornate gold jewelry and a simple white linen wrap. The architecture behind her is warm stone with carved serpent motifs — Xikxia's palace. [NEGATIVE BLOCK]

    WOLVESFOLK¶

    Mood: Firelight Night / Alpine Cold

    A wolvesfolk huntress standing at the edge of a snow-covered forest under a full moon. She has wolf ears, a thick gray-white tail, and silver-gray fur on her arms and cheeks. She is humanoid but distinctly lupine — sharp amber eyes, elongated canines visible when her mouth is slightly open. She wears thick furs and leather wrapped against the cold. She is looking up at the moon, mouth slightly open as if mid-howl. Around her neck, a carved bone pendant. The snow glows pale blue in the moonlight. [NEGATIVE BLOCK]

    DEMONS¶

    Mood: Firelight / Overcast

    A demon woman standing on a balcony overlooking the black soil of the Demon Continent at dusk. She has deep crimson skin, curved horns sweeping back from her forehead, and intelligent amber eyes. She wears elegant but practical dark robes with silver clasps — the fashion of the Asatru Empire. Her expression is contemplative, not menacing. She is a scholar, a veteran's descendant, a civilized being. Behind her, the architecture is gothic and refined — carved stone, tall windows, candlelight spilling from within. The black land below stretches to the horizon. [NEGATIVE BLOCK]

    DRAGONS (Kramsadar)¶

    Mood: Overcast Gray / Alpine Cold

    An elderly dragon woman — humanoid form — standing at the mouth of an ice cave high in the polar mountains. She has pale silver-white scales along her cheekbones and forearms, slit-pupiled violet eyes, and long white hair whipping in the frozen wind. She wears heavy furs over simple robes. Her expression is ancient and patient — she has lived in isolation for millennia. Behind her, the cave walls glitter with frost. Outside, tundra stretches to the horizon under a gray sky. [NEGATIVE BLOCK]

    ANGELS¶

    Mood: Misty Dawn / Alpine Cold

    An angel woman standing alone on a frozen mountain peak at dawn. She has large white feathered wings folded behind her, pale skin that seems to glow faintly, and luminous silver eyes. Her hair is white-gold and flows past her shoulders. She wears simple white and silver robes that seem too light for the cold — she does not feel it. Her expression is serene but distant, like someone who has been alone with their thoughts for centuries. Mist curls around the peaks below her. The sky is pale pink and gray. [NEGATIVE BLOCK]

    HALFLINGS¶

    Mood: Golden Hour

    A halfling woman standing in the round doorway of her hillside burrow-home at golden hour. She is short and round-faced with curly auburn hair, rosy cheeks, and large hairy bare feet. She wears a simple apron over a comfortable dress. She holds a wooden spoon in one hand and is waving cheerfully with the other. The round wooden door behind her is painted green, flower boxes under the circular windows. Smoke curls from the chimney in the grassy hill above. This is Barro and Kob — simple, peaceful, happy. [NEGATIVE BLOCK]

    COLDSPEOPLE¶

    Mood: Alpine Cold / Misty Dawn

    A Coldspeople elder standing outside an ice-carved dwelling in deep winter. She is stocky and broad-shouldered, covered in thick pale fur from head to foot. Her face is round with small ears — adapted to minimize heat loss. Her paw-like hands rest on a carved ice staff. She wears layered furs over her natural coat. Her expression is warm despite the frozen environment. Behind her, the village is carved from glacial ice — homes sculpted from packed snow, fur drapes over the doorways. The sky is pale blue, almost white. [NEGATIVE BLOCK]

    SANDSMEN¶

    Mood: Desert Sun

    A Sandsmen scout standing at the entrance to an underground city carved into sandstone cliffs. He is tall and lean with sand-gold skin and protective membranes over his dark eyes. He wears light linen wraps in desert tones, a scarf over his lower face. Behind him, stairs descend into darkness — the surface is only the visible fraction of Malbodor. The desert stretches endlessly behind him under a blazing sun. Heat haze shimmers on the horizon. [NEGATIVE BLOCK]

    DIABLOS¶

    Mood: Firelight Night / Swamp Gloom

    A Diablos woman perched on a cliff edge at night, her large bat-like wings half-spread behind her. She has deep indigo skin, large reflective eyes that glow faintly, and sharp elegant features. Her hair is dark and short. She wears dark leather wraps and silver piercings. Behind her, the moon shines through thin clouds. Far below, the lights of her mountain settlement flicker — homes built into the cliff face, accessible only by flight. She looks utterly at home in the darkness. [NEGATIVE BLOCK]

    FLAMES¶

    Mood: Desert Sun / Firelight

    A Flame being standing in a mountain cavern, their body composed of shifting orange and blue gas in humanoid shape, a bright white core visible at the center of their chest. The form is feminine in silhouette but clearly not flesh — translucent, flickering, otherworldly. They are touching the mineral-rich cave wall with one gaseous hand, absorbing trace elements. The cavern glows with reflected firelight. Crystals embedded in the rock sparkle. [NEGATIVE BLOCK]

    GIANTS¶

    Mood: Ocean Dusk / Alpine Cold

    A Giant woman standing on the rocky coast of Xobkua island at dusk. She is enormous — the scale is shown by the small fishing boat pulled up on the shore beside her, barely reaching her knee. She has a strong, weathered face, dark hair tied back, and simple clothes of stitched leather and coarse wool. Her hands are calloused from woodworking. She looks out to sea with quiet dignity. Behind her, a massive longhouse — beams weighing tons, fitted without nails — dwarfs even her frame. [NEGATIVE BLOCK]

    OGRES¶

    Mood: Swamp Gloom

    An ogre woman standing knee-deep in a still green swamp, one massive hand resting on a gnarled walking staff. She is large — two and a half meters — with olive-green skin, small tusks, and a surprisingly gentle expression. She wears simple rough-spun clothes. Mud sculptures — crude but expressive faces — decorate the bank behind her. Her swamp-home is a hut built on stilts among the cypress trees. Fireflies blink in the humid dusk air. She looks like someone who wants to be left alone with her thoughts. [NEGATIVE BLOCK]

    KUTRA (OWLKIN)¶

    Mood: Overcast / Swamp Gloom

    A Kutra woman perched on a wooden platform built half-above and half-below a wide river. She has the head of an owl — large forward-facing eyes, a short beak, feathery facial disc — on a humanoid body with wing-like arms and taloned feet. Her feathers are mottled brown and gray, perfect camouflage. She is mid-gesture with one wing-hand, communicating in the silent sign-language of her people. Below her, submerged sleeping chambers glow with bioluminescent light. [NEGATIVE BLOCK]

    YAOMA (MERFOLK)¶

    Mood: Ocean Dusk

    A Yaoma woman floating just below the surface of crystal-clear tropical water at sunset. Her upper body is humanoid with pale blue-green skin, webbed hands, and long flowing hair that drifts in the current. Her lower body transitions into a powerful scaled tail catching the pink-orange light from above. Her expression is serene — she is singing, and bubbles rise from her lips. Coral formations and tropical fish surround her. Through the water's surface, two islands are visible on the horizon. [NEGATIVE BLOCK]

    INTELLIGENT SLIMES¶

    Mood: Swamp Gloom

    An intelligent slime from the Glub Kingdom, sitting in a simple stone chamber. Their body is a translucent blue-green gelatinous mass in a roughly humanoid shape, with a brighter cluster of thinking-cells visible near where a head would be. They are "speaking" — thin tendrils of gel extend toward a mineral sample on a stone table, absorbing trace salts. The room is minimalist — slimes need no furniture. Wet stone walls glisten. It is unsettling and beautiful at once. [NEGATIVE BLOCK]

    SEAFOLK¶

    Mood: Ocean Dusk

    A Seafolk woman standing on the deck of a stilt-house built over shallow coastal water. She has pale blue-green tinted skin, slightly webbed hands, and large dark eyes adapted for underwater vision. She wears simple woven sea-grass clothing. Behind her, the village extends across the water — dozens of homes on stilts connected by rope bridges, boats tied to every post. The sun sets over the ocean, turning the water gold. She is coiling a fishing net with practiced ease. [NEGATIVE BLOCK]

    HIGH CATMEN¶

    Mood: Golden Hour

    A High Catmen woman standing on a marble balcony overlooking the city of Marko at sunset. She has black hair, dark Mediterranean features, cat ears and a tail, and a strong, composed presence. Unlike the playful Lesser Catmen or wandering Erisdarian Catmen, she carries herself like a statesman. She wears elegant diplomatic robes in deep blue with gold trim. One hand rests on the stone railing. She is about to address the international council. Behind her, the architecture blends catmen whimsy with classical columns. [NEGATIVE BLOCK]

    MERRATODONIAN CATMEN¶

    Mood: Swamp Gloom / Overcast

    A Merratodonian Catmen woman crouching on a thick tree branch deep in the forested interior of Merratodoni. She has forest-green and brown fur, larger ears than other catmen — adapted for navigating dense canopy. Her build is lean and agile. She wears minimal clothing — leather wraps, pouches for tools. Dappled green light filters through the leaves above. She is perfectly still, listening. Somewhere in the distance, a bird calls. [NEGATIVE BLOCK]

    EASTERN BEASTMEN¶

    Mood: Golden Hour / Desert Sun

    An Eastern Beastmen trader woman standing at a market stall in the Cammao Kingdom at golden hour. She has dog-like ears and a tail, a shorter build than western beastmen, and a bright, shrewd expression. She wears practical merchant's clothes with many pockets. Behind her, the stall displays goods from across Lumina — spices, cloth, crafted tools. She is gesturing with one hand mid-negotiation. Other species — a demon merchant, a catmen courier — move through the market behind her. [NEGATIVE BLOCK]

    KOEBI¶

    Mood: Firelight / Overcast

    A Koebi woman — a demon subrace — meditating in a stone chamber carved from a single boulder. She is tall with forest-green skin, long curved horns, and amber eyes half-closed in concentration. Her hands rest on her knees, palms up. She wears simple brown robes. The walls around her are masterfully carved with geometric patterns — the work of Koebi craftsmen. A single shaft of light enters from above, illuminating dust motes. This is Vash-ka — the sacred practice of meditation through stillness. [NEGATIVE BLOCK]

    EMBERALDEN LIZARDFOLK¶

    Mood: Desert Sun

    An Emberalden Lizardfolk huntress returning from a successful hunt at golden hour. She is tall for a kobold — nearly human height — with copper-brown scales, a thick muscular tail, and a reptilian face with intelligent yellow eyes. She carries a spear over one shoulder and drags a small game animal behind her. Her expression is proud but not arrogant — she fed her clan today. Behind her, the landscape of the Demon Continent stretches in black and red tones. Stone surface-dwellings are visible in the distance — the Emberalden village. [NEGATIVE BLOCK]

    YAK (ORC SUBRACE)¶

    Mood: Firelight

    A Yak woman — a smaller, more modest orc subrace — sitting cross-legged in a weaving workshop. She has gray-green skin, small tusks filed smooth, and a calm, focused expression. Her hands work a loom with practiced precision. She wears simple undyed wool clothing. The room around her is filled with beautiful woven tapestries and pottery — Yak craftsmanship. Warm firelight from a clay hearth illuminates the scene. A small bowl of grain sits on the windowsill — an offering to the ancestors who watch through the eyes of birds. [NEGATIVE BLOCK]
